verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ingests events through Sentry's open-source SDKs and states it aims to be Sentry API compatible, so that anything working with Sentry should also work with it. Community users confirm this in practice, including newer third-party reporters such as Svelte. This delivers the core of the story: compatible clients can send events without any GlitchTip-specific SDK. Missing for 10: GlitchTip-hosted documentation of the ingestion protocol or envelope/store endpoints, evidence of hand-built custom clients, and a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
